correctness.rationale: The stationary inverse is entrywise positive and gives an explicit positive determinant. The sum derivative is a strictly increasing quadratic numerator divided by that determinant squared. The sign of T1-T2 gives a unique candidate for temperature equalization; implicit differentiation makes the hottest cell strictly improve toward equality where feasible. At equality the derivative of the sum is -(H1-H2)/D<0, giving the strict threshold and optimizer ordering for unequal positive sources. The exact rational replay in VERIFICATION.md is supplementary.

value.rationale: The positivity regime gives a qualitative feature absent from the single-source model: the peak-optimal split has its own finite activation and then equalizes temperature, yet the sum-optimal split always puts more into the lower-source cell above the first threshold. The exact joint diagram makes this objective tradeoff usable as a benchmark in a common two-state model, with no empirical extrapolation.
